name: PSSHI_HalfEdge
rationale: The failure on S4 for PSSHI_Zener is likely caused by the output voltage being pushed too firmly into the Zener clamp limit, leading to a long settling time (dv) and higher ripple. By changing the PSSHI switch (S1) to trigger only on one edge (pos), we reduce the power delivered per cycle. This should lower Vout slightly, reducing the settling time and ripple on S4 while remaining above the 1.8V minimum.
